Messages.Body:
d...@dlep1.itg.ti.com (Dick Johnson) writes:

>Our playing group is in disagreement as to the order
>of strikes. What is the correct order of:
>
> Strike: combat ends
> : steal blood
> : dodge
> : first strike
> : strike.
>

First Strike is a meta-qualifier (can be applied to steal blood, for instance)

Resolve as follows:
1) Combat Ends
2) Dodge
3) First Strikes
3.a) Heal damage (spend blood) for first strikes
4) Regular Strikes
4.a) Heal damage (spend blood) for regular strikes

Messages.Author: up and crumbling
Messages.Body:
In article <49n3sj$1...@tilde.csc.ti.com>,

Dick Johnson <d...@dlep1.itg.ti.com> wrote:
>Our playing group is in disagreement as to the order
>of strikes. What is the correct order of:

> Strike: combat ends
> : steal blood
> : dodge
> : first strike
> : strike.

Combat Ends beats Dodge. Dodge beats First Strike. First Strike beats
Strike.

Note that Steal Blood is just like any other strike, timing wise:

Aleph and Beth are in combat. Aleph steals n blood. Beth srikes for n
damage. Strikes resolve: Aleph takes n damage and gains n blood, which
he uses to heal the damaged. Note that rulings have flopped about a bit
on this issue, but have been stable of late.
